text: 我可以告诉你：Aradesh-亚拉德什、Dharma-先知达玛、Tandi-坦蒂、Razlo-拉斯洛、Raiders-歹徒、Vipers-蝮蛇帮、Khans-可汗帮、Scorpions-辐射蝎、Claw-死亡爪、Junktown-迦克镇、Spear-矛、Station-小镇的哨所、Lair-巢穴、Scorpion-辐射蝎、Tower-小镇的了望塔、Seth-赛思。

text: You see Aradesh.
source_text: You see Aradesh.

text: 你看见亚拉德什。
source_text: 你看见亚拉德什。

text: Greetings, wanderer. Please do not be offended if the#gentlefolk about seem rude. As Dharma said, 'Tough#times tan the human hide.' Your business in Shady#Sands might be?
source_text:
Greetings, wanderer. Please do not be offended if the
#gentlefolk about seem rude. As Dharma said, 'Tough
#times tan the human hide.' Your business in Shady
#Sands might be?

text: 你好，旅行者。这里的居民们或许有点粗鲁，但不要生气。达玛说：“乱世能让人坚强。”你来沙荫镇有何贵干？
source_text: 你好，旅行者。这里的居民们或许有点粗鲁，但不要生气。达玛说：“乱世能让人坚强。”你来沙荫镇有何贵干？

text: Greetings. Your business in Shady Sands might be?
source_text: Greetings. Your business in Shady Sands might be?

text: 你好。你来沙荫镇有何贵干？
source_text: 你好。你来沙荫镇有何贵干？

text: We don't take to strangers much. Your business in#Shady Sands?
source_text:
We don't take to strangers much. Your business in
#Shady Sands?

text: 我们这里很少有外来者。你来沙荫镇有何贵干？
source_text: 我们这里很少有外来者。你来沙荫镇有何贵干？

text: I'm from a small village west of here. I'm just#exploring and mean you no harm.
source_text:
I'm from a small village west of here. I'm just
#exploring and mean you no harm.

text: 我从西面的一个小村子来。我只是在探险，没有恶意。
source_text: 我从西面的一个小村子来。我只是在探险，没有恶意。

text: What's it to you?
source_text: What's it to you?

text: 关你什么事？
source_text: 关你什么事？

text: My reasons are mine to keep.
source_text: My reasons are mine to keep.

text: 我保留我的理由。
source_text: 我保留我的理由。

text: I'm from a Vault to the west. My people are dying#of thirst and I need to find a water purifier chip#for them to survive.
source_text:
I'm from a Vault to the west. My people are dying
#of thirst and I need to find a water purifier chip
#for them to survive.

text: 我从西面的一个避难所来。我的人正受到颗缺水渴死的危险，我要找一个净水芯片让他们能活下去。
source_text: 我从西面的一个避难所来。我的人正受到颗缺水渴死的危险，我要找一个净水芯片让他们能活下去。

text: I'm saving an entire people from destruction!
source_text: I'm saving an entire people from destruction!

text: 我正在救民于水火！
source_text: 我正在救民于水火！

text: Shady Sands? Whoops, I'm lost! I'll just be going now.
source_text: Shady Sands? Whoops, I'm lost! I'll just be going now.

text: 沙荫镇？哎呀，我迷路了！我得走了。
source_text: 沙荫镇？哎呀，我迷路了！我得走了。

text: Hunh?
source_text: Hunh?

text: 哈？
source_text: 哈？

text: I know of no village to the west.
source_text: I know of no village to the west.

text: 据我所知西面没有村子。
source_text: 据我所知西面没有村子。

text: Have you been through the mountains west of here?
source_text: Have you been through the mountains west of here?

text: 你翻过这里西面的山吗？
source_text: 你翻过这里西面的山吗？

text: So?
source_text: So?

text: 那么？
source_text: 那么？

text: Are you saying you know every location from here#to the ocean?
source_text:
Are you saying you know every location from here
#to the ocean?

text: 你的意思是，你了解从这里到海洋的每个地方？
source_text: 你的意思是，你了解从这里到海洋的每个地方？

text: I'm sure you've been many places, but you must have#missed my tiny village.
source_text:
I'm sure you've been many places, but you must have
#missed my tiny village.

text: 我相信你到过很多地方，不过你一定遗漏了我在的小村庄。
source_text: 我相信你到过很多地方，不过你一定遗漏了我在的小村庄。

text: Ah well, to my regret, I have not. Which begs the question,#how did you make that passage?
source_text:
Ah well, to my regret, I have not. Which begs the question,
#how did you make that passage?

text: 哦，那么，很遗憾，我没有。那么让我重复一次我的问题，你是怎么到这里的？
source_text: 哦，那么，很遗憾，我没有。那么让我重复一次我的问题，你是怎么到这里的？

text: It was pretty tough, but I made it.
source_text: It was pretty tough, but I made it.

text: 很辛苦，不过我还是走过来了。
source_text: 很辛苦，不过我还是走过来了。

text: What's it to you?
source_text: What's it to you?

text: 与你何干？
source_text: 与你何干？

text: Look, all I wanted was a few supplies and things,#but I will gladly go elsewhere.
source_text:
Look, all I wanted was a few supplies and things,
#but I will gladly go elsewhere.

text: 听着，我想要的只是一些补给和其它东西，不过我也不是非要在你们这里搞到这些。
source_text: 听着，我想要的只是一些补给和其它东西，不过我也不是非要在你们这里搞到这些。

text: I don't need to answer you.
source_text: I don't need to answer you.

text: 我不需要回答你。
source_text: 我不需要回答你。

text: Yes, hmmm, yes, yes. yes. I shall believe you...for now.#But we do not trust easily, especially those who might be dangerous.#Know that Seth and I will be watching you.
source_text:
Yes, hmmm, yes, yes. yes. I shall believe you...for now.
#But we do not trust easily, especially those who might be dangerous.
#Know that Seth and I will be watching you.

text: 好的，嗯，对，对，对。我应该相信你……目下而言。不过我们不会轻易信任别人，特别是对于那些可能是危险分子的人。你要明白，塞思和我会盯着你的一举一动。
source_text: 好的，嗯，对，对，对。我应该相信你……目下而言。不过我们不会轻易信任别人，特别是对于那些可能是危险分子的人。你要明白，塞思和我会盯着你的一举一动。

text: It is my town, wanderer. You must answer my questions#or leave. This is not a matter of choice.
source_text:
It is my town, wanderer. You must answer my questions
#or leave. This is not a matter of choice.

text: 这是我的城镇，旅行者，你要么回答我的问题要么离开这里。这里没你选择的余地。
source_text: 这是我的城镇，旅行者，你要么回答我的问题要么离开这里。这里没你选择的余地。

text: I don't have to tell you anything.
source_text: I don't have to tell you anything.

text: 我不必告诉你任何事情。
source_text: 我不必告诉你任何事情。

text: I mean you no harm, really.
source_text: I mean you no harm, really.

text: 我对你没有恶意，真的。
source_text: 我对你没有恶意，真的。

text: Don't worry, I'm leaving.
source_text: Don't worry, I'm leaving.

text: 别担心，我就走。
source_text: 别担心，我就走。

text: You are quite insolent. I believe you should leave. Do#not return. You will not be welcome.
source_text:
You are quite insolent. I believe you should leave. Do
#not return. You will not be welcome.

text: 你相当无礼。我想你应该离开。别回来。你不会受欢迎的。
source_text: 你相当无礼。我想你应该离开。别回来。你不会受欢迎的。

text: So be it, wanderer. Seth will show you out.
source_text: So be it, wanderer. Seth will show you out.

text: 随你，旅行者。塞思会请你出去的。
source_text: 随你，旅行者。塞思会请你出去的。

text: You must think me quite gullible, wanderer. You#conquered the mountains by yourself?
source_text:
You must think me quite gullible, wanderer. You
#conquered the mountains by yourself?

text: 你以为我很好骗吗，旅行者。你一个人翻过了那些山脉？
source_text: 你以为我很好骗吗，旅行者。你一个人翻过了那些山脉？

text: Doesn't matter how I think. It's true I came#from the mountains.
source_text:
Doesn't matter how I think. It's true I came
#from the mountains.

text: 我怎么想不重要。我从那些山脉翻过来是事实。
source_text: 我怎么想不重要。我从那些山脉翻过来是事实。

text: No, just stupid.
source_text: No, just stupid.

text: 不，仅仅是愚蠢而已。
source_text: 不，仅仅是愚蠢而已。

text: As Dharma said, 'Caution is life in troubled times.'#Your origin is not the issue. Your intent is.
source_text:
As Dharma said, 'Caution is life in troubled times.'
#Your origin is not the issue. Your intent is.

text: 如达玛所说，“小心驶得万年船”，你从哪里来并不是问题。重要的是你来此地的用意。
source_text: 如达玛所说，“小心驶得万年船”，你从哪里来并不是问题。重要的是你来此地的用意。

text: Okay.
source_text: Okay.

text: 好吧。
source_text: 好吧。

text: I will let you pass, but know this: Seth and I will#watch you very, very closely. Do not even consider#bringing trouble here.
source_text:
I will let you pass, but know this: Seth and I will
#watch you very, very closely. Do not even consider
#bringing trouble here.

text: 我就不再盘问你了，不过你要记住：塞思和我会很小心、很小心地盯着你的。如果想在这里惹麻烦，你还是省省吧。
source_text: 我就不再盘问你了，不过你要记住：塞思和我会很小心、很小心地盯着你的。如果想在这里惹麻烦，你还是省省吧。

text: And keep them you may. But this is not a city of#open hospitality. If you desire that, go to Junktown.#You may enter, but know we have our eyes on you.
source_text:
And keep them you may. But this is not a city of
#open hospitality. If you desire that, go to Junktown.
#You may enter, but know we have our eyes on you.

text: 你可以不说。不过这里不是一个公开好客的地方。如果你想的话，去迦克镇。你可以进得我们的镇子，不过你要知道，我们会盯着你的。
source_text: 你可以不说。不过这里不是一个公开好客的地方。如果你想的话，去迦克镇。你可以进得我们的镇子，不过你要知道，我们会盯着你的。

text: A Vault. How shall I trust you, wanderer, when you#are not honest with me?
source_text:
A Vault. How shall I trust you, wanderer, when you
#are not honest with me?

text: 一个避难所？我怎么能相信你呢，旅行者，你说的不是实话吧？
source_text: 一个避难所？我怎么能相信你呢，旅行者，你说的不是实话吧？

text: No, honestly, I come from a Vault!
source_text: No, honestly, I come from a Vault!

text: 实际上，我从一个避难所来的！
source_text: 实际上，我从一个避难所来的！

text: The Vault is . . . the name of my village.
source_text: The Vault is . . . the name of my village.

text: 这“避难所”是……是我村子的名称。
source_text: 这“避难所”是……是我村子的名称。

text: You're right, I was lying.
source_text: You're right, I was lying.

text: 你说对了，我是在撒谎。
source_text: 你说对了，我是在撒谎。

text: Hmmm, yes, yes, yes. Then tell me of this Vault.
source_text: Hmmm, yes, yes, yes. Then tell me of this Vault.

text: 嗯，对对对。那么就给说说这个避难所。
source_text: 嗯，对对对。那么就给说说这个避难所。

text: Well . . . the Vault is actually the name of my town.#We name it that because it's in between two big cliffs.
source_text:
Well . . . the Vault is actually the name of my town.
#We name it that because it's in between two big cliffs.

text: 呃……避难所其实就是我在城镇的名称。我们取这个名字是因为它在两个大峭壁的中间。
source_text: 呃……避难所其实就是我在城镇的名称。我们取这个名字是因为它在两个大峭壁的中间。

text: It's a big place built into a mountain far to the west.#My people have been there for the last 80 years.
source_text:
It's a big place built into a mountain far to the west.
#My people have been there for the last 80 years.

text: 那是一个建在遥远西面的一座山中的一个很大的地方。我的人民已经在那里居住了80年了。
source_text: 那是一个建在遥远西面的一座山中的一个很大的地方。我的人民已经在那里居住了80年了。

text: Why do you want to know?
source_text: Why do you want to know?

text: 你为什么想知道？
source_text: 你为什么想知道？

text: Wanderer, I shall believe you . . . for now. You may#enter Shady Sands, but be warned your every move will be watched.
source_text:
Wanderer, I shall believe you . . . for now. You may
#enter Shady Sands, but be warned your every move will be watched.

text: 旅行者，我可以相信你……只是现在。你可以进入沙荫镇，不过我告诫你，你的所有举动都会被注意。
source_text: 旅行者，我可以相信你……只是现在。你可以进入沙荫镇，不过我告诫你，你的所有举动都会被注意。

text: I will not be lied to, wanderer.
source_text: I will not be lied to, wanderer.

text: 不要对我撒慌，旅行者。
source_text: 不要对我撒慌，旅行者。

text: I don't have to tell you anything.
source_text: I don't have to tell you anything.

text: 我不需要告诉你任何事。
source_text: 我不需要告诉你任何事。

text: I mean you no harm, really.
source_text: I mean you no harm, really.

text: 我没有恶意，真的。
source_text: 我没有恶意，真的。

text: Don't worry, I'm leaving.
source_text: Don't worry, I'm leaving.

text: 别担心，我就走。
source_text: 别担心，我就走。

text: Hmmm. You may enter. But stay out of trouble.
source_text: Hmmm. You may enter. But stay out of trouble.

text: 嗯。你可以进我们的镇子。不过别惹麻烦。
source_text: 嗯。你可以进我们的镇子。不过别惹麻烦。

text: What can you tell me about the other towns around here?
source_text: What can you tell me about the other towns around here?

text: 你能给我说说这附近城镇的情况吗？
source_text: 你能给我说说这附近城镇的情况吗？

text: What's going on around here?
source_text: What's going on around here?

text: 镇子里最近有什么事吗？
source_text: 镇子里最近有什么事吗？

text: Thanks. Bye.
source_text: Thanks. Bye.

text: 谢谢。再见。
source_text: 谢谢。再见。

text: Greetings again, young wanderer. I hope your stay here has been pleasant.
source_text: Greetings again, young wanderer. I hope your stay here has been pleasant.

text: 你好，又再见了，年轻的旅行者。我希望你在镇子里过的愉快。

text: It's been great. Can I ask you some questions?

text: 这里很不错。我可以问些问题吗？
source_text: 这里很不错。我可以问些问题吗？

text: It has. I gotta run though.
source_text: It has. I gotta run though.

text: 是的。不过我该走了。
source_text: 是的。不过我该走了。

text: If you like sewers.
source_text: If you like sewers.

text: 和下水道一样的破镇子。
source_text: 和下水道一样的破镇子。

text: Nuh-huh.
source_text: Nuh-huh.

text: 嗯嗯。
source_text: 嗯嗯。

text: Greetings. What may I help you with this fine day?
source_text: Greetings. What may I help you with this fine day?

text: 你好。天气不错，我有什么能帮你吗？
source_text: 你好。天气不错，我有什么能帮你吗？

text: Is there something you want?
source_text: Is there something you want?

text: 你有什么事？
source_text: 你有什么事？

text: Can you tell me about Shady Sands?
source_text: Can you tell me about Shady Sands?

text: 你能告诉我一些关于沙荫镇的事情吗？
source_text: 你能告诉我一些关于沙荫镇的事情吗？

text: I was wondering if I could ask you a few questions?
source_text: I was wondering if I could ask you a few questions?

text: 我想我可以问你一些问题吗？
source_text: 我想我可以问你一些问题吗？

text: Nothing, really, I was just leaving.
source_text: Nothing, really, I was just leaving.

text: 没事，真的没事，我要走了。
source_text: 没事，真的没事，我要走了。

text: Nuh-uh.
source_text: Nuh-uh.

text: 嗯嗯。
source_text: 嗯嗯。

text: Certainly. What do you wish to know?
source_text: Certainly. What do you wish to know?

text: 当然可以。你希望知道什么？
source_text: 当然可以。你希望知道什么？

text: You may ask, but please hurry. There are more important uses for my time.
source_text: You may ask, but please hurry. There are more important uses for my time.

text: 你可以问，不过请快点。我还有更重要的事情要费神。
source_text: 你可以问，不过请快点。我还有更重要的事情要费神。

text: What can you tell me about the other towns around here?

source_text: 你能给我说说这附近城镇的情况吗？

text: What's going on around here?
source_text: What's going on around here?

text: 镇子里最近有什么事吗？
source_text: 镇子里最近有什么事吗？

text: Thanks. Bye.
source_text: Thanks. Bye.

text: 谢谢。再见。
source_text: 谢谢。再见。

text: Ah. Happy journeys, wanderer.
source_text: Ah. Happy journeys, wanderer.

text: 啊。祝你旅途愉快，旅行者。
source_text: 啊。祝你旅途愉快，旅行者。

text: Goodbye.
source_text: Goodbye.

text: 再见。
source_text: 再见。

text: I certainly hope so.
source_text: I certainly hope so.

text: 求之不得。
source_text: 求之不得。

text: Dharma said, 'A man and his wayward tongue are soon parted.' Come back#when you have learned some manners.
source_text:
Dharma said, 'A man and his wayward tongue are soon parted.' Come back
#when you have learned some manners.

text: 达玛说过，“无礼的舌头总有被割掉的一天。”等你什么时候懂得礼貌了再回来吧。
source_text: 达玛说过，“无礼的舌头总有被割掉的一天。”等你什么时候懂得礼貌了再回来吧。

text: That is quite enough, wanderer. Seth will show#you out of the city. Do not return. Your welcome will not be pleasant.
source_text:
That is quite enough, wanderer. Seth will show
#you out of the city. Do not return. Your welcome will not be pleasant.

text: 这就实在是够了，旅行者。赛思会带你出城去。不要回来。和你交往很不愉快。
source_text: 这就实在是够了，旅行者。赛思会带你出城去。不要回来。和你交往很不愉快。

text: Shady Sands is much like a family, one that keeps#to itself.
source_text:
Shady Sands is much like a family, one that keeps
#to itself.

text: 沙荫镇很有家庭的感觉，自给自足。
source_text: 沙荫镇很有家庭的感觉，自给自足。

text: We are a very protective community. As Dharma said,#'Many sticks can be broken. A bundle cannot.'
source_text:
We are a very protective community. As Dharma said,
#'Many sticks can be broken. A bundle cannot.'

text: 我们是一个很有自我保护意识的社区。如达玛所说，“一根筷子轻轻被折断，十根筷子牢牢抱成团。”
source_text: 我们是一个很有自我保护意识的社区。如达玛所说，“一根筷子轻轻被折断，十根筷子牢牢抱成团。”

text: What kind of things do you have around here?
source_text: What kind of things do you have around here?

text: 镇子里有什么事情吗？
source_text: 镇子里有什么事情吗？

text: Interesting. Are there any other cities around here?
source_text: Interesting. Are there any other cities around here?

text: 有意思。这附近有任何其它城市吗？
source_text: 有意思。这附近有任何其它城市吗？

text: How cute. Well, I better be going.
source_text: How cute. Well, I better be going.

text: 真精辟啊。那么，我最好还是走吧。
source_text: 真精辟啊。那么，我最好还是走吧。

text: The Gardens are on the south side. The Brahma Pens#are north, although the smell is, I fear, quite intense this time of year.
source_text:
The Gardens are on the south side. The Brahma Pens
#are north, although the smell is, I fear, quite intense this time of year.

text: 花园在南边。双头牛场在北边，虽然那里的气味实在是，我恐怕，在每年的这个时候相当强烈。
source_text: 花园在南边。双头牛场在北边，虽然那里的气味实在是，我恐怕，在每年的这个时候相当强烈。

text: Anything else?
source_text: Anything else?

text: 还有什么吗？
source_text: 还有什么吗？

text: We are small and self sufficient so there is little else#to tell.
source_text:
We are small and self sufficient so there is little else
#to tell.

text: 我们是自给自足的小地方，所以没有多少说的。
source_text: 我们是自给自足的小地方，所以没有多少说的。

text: Thanks. Can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: Thanks. Can I ask you a few more questions?

text: 谢谢。我可以多问一些问题吗？
source_text: 谢谢。我可以多问一些问题吗？

text: Thanks. Bye.
source_text: Thanks. Bye.

text: 谢谢。再见。
source_text: 谢谢。再见。

text: It is a small place. You have feet.
source_text: It is a small place. You have feet.

text: 这是一个小地方。你抬脚走一圈就明白了。
source_text: 这是一个小地方。你抬脚走一圈就明白了。

text: Thanks. Can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: Thanks. Can I ask you a few more questions?

text: 谢谢。我可以多问一些问题吗？
source_text: 谢谢。我可以多问一些问题吗？

text: Dharma said, 'Heed not the call of the wolf when the fox is raiding#the hen house.'
source_text:
Dharma said, 'Heed not the call of the wolf when the fox is raiding
#the hen house.'

text: 达玛说，“杀鸡何用宰牛刀。”
source_text: 达玛说，“杀鸡何用宰牛刀。”

text: Junktown lies south of here, though there is little in#the way of visitation. From stories, I'm certain there#are cities south of that.
source_text:
Junktown lies south of here, though there is little in
#the way of visitation. From stories, I'm certain there
#are cities south of that.

text: 迦克镇在这里的南方，到那里的路上几乎没有其他镇子了。从各种传言来看，我很肯定迦克镇的南面还有不少城市。
source_text: 迦克镇在这里的南方，到那里的路上几乎没有其他镇子了。从各种传言来看，我很肯定迦克镇的南面还有不少城市。

text: Thanks. I . . . Can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: Thanks. I . . . Can I ask you a few more questions?

text: 谢谢。我……我可以再问一些问题吗？
source_text: 谢谢。我……我可以再问一些问题吗？

text: It is a quiet time, thankfully.
source_text: It is a quiet time, thankfully.

text: 幸运的，现在还没有什么事。
source_text: 幸运的，现在还没有什么事。

text: Sounds . . . boring
source_text: Sounds . . . boring

text: 听起来……挺闷。
source_text: 听起来……挺闷。

text: Well, then, can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: Well, then, can I ask you a few more questions?

text: 嗯，那么，我可以再多问几个问题吗？
source_text: 嗯，那么，我可以再多问几个问题吗？

text: Good. Hopefully it will stay that way for a while.
source_text: Good. Hopefully it will stay that way for a while.

text: 好。希望这样能维持一段时间。
source_text: 好。希望这样能维持一段时间。

text: Yes. We like it that way.
source_text: Yes. We like it that way.

text: 是的。我希望能如此。
source_text: 是的。我希望能如此。

text: What can you tell me about the other towns around here?
source_text: What can you tell me about the other towns around here?

text: 你能告诉我关于这里附近城镇的一些事吗？
source_text: 你能告诉我关于这里附近城镇的一些事吗？

text: What's going on around here?
source_text: What's going on around here?

text: 这里最近怎么样了？
source_text: 这里最近怎么样了？

text: Thanks. Bye.
source_text: Thanks. Bye.

text: 谢谢。再见。
source_text: 谢谢。再见。

text: Oh my yes. Great packs of Rad Scorpions are killing#our herds. We don't know where they're from, and no#matter how many we kill, there's always more!
source_text:
Oh my yes. Great packs of Rad Scorpions are killing
#our herds. We don't know where they're from, and no
#matter how many we kill, there's always more!

text: 哦，确实有。一大群辐射蝎正在杀我们的牛群。我们不知道他们从哪里来的，而且不管我们杀了多少辐射蝎，那里总会有更多的出现。
source_text: 哦，确实有。一大群辐射蝎正在杀我们的牛群。我们不知道他们从哪里来的，而且不管我们杀了多少辐射蝎，那里总会有更多的出现。

text: Go on.
source_text: Go on.

text: 继续。
source_text: 继续。

text: And now the monsters are attacking my people! Razlo#is trying to find a cure for their poison, but I'm not#sure how it goes.
source_text:
And now the monsters are attacking my people! Razlo
#is trying to find a cure for their poison, but I'm not
#sure how it goes.

text: 而且现在这些怪物正在攻击我的人民！拉斯洛正在寻找一种治疗蝎毒的方法，不过我不知道进展如何了。
source_text: 而且现在这些怪物正在攻击我的人民！拉斯洛正在寻找一种治疗蝎毒的方法，不过我不知道进展如何了。

text: Well, I'll help you get rid of these things!
source_text: Well, I'll help you get rid of these things!

text: 好，我会帮你消灭那些东西！
source_text: 好，我会帮你消灭那些东西！

text: I can help you for a price.
source_text: I can help you for a price.

text: 我可以帮助你，不过需要一定的代价。
source_text: 我可以帮助你，不过需要一定的代价。

text: That's terrible. Can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: That's terrible. Can I ask you a few more questions?

text: 那真糟糕。我能再问你一些问题吗？
source_text: 那真糟糕。我能再问你一些问题吗？

text: Ummm, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes! Please talk to Razlo. He#possesses far more information on these creatures than I.
source_text:
Ummm, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes! Please talk to Razlo. He
#possesses far more information on these creatures than I.

text: 嗯，好，好，好，好，好！请跟拉斯洛谈谈。他比我更清楚那种生物的事情。
source_text: 嗯，好，好，好，好，好！请跟拉斯洛谈谈。他比我更清楚那种生物的事情。

text: As Dharma said, 'Those who tend their own flock,#know the shepherd.'
source_text:
As Dharma said, 'Those who tend their own flock,
#know the shepherd.'

text: 如达玛所说，“不在其位，不谋其政。”
source_text: 如达玛所说，“不在其位，不谋其政。”

text: I know it's hard for you to trust, but I would like#to help.
source_text:
I know it's hard for you to trust, but I would like
#to help.

text: 我知道你还不太信任我，不过我真的想帮帮忙。
source_text: 我知道你还不太信任我，不过我真的想帮帮忙。

text: Your choice. Can I ask you some more questions?
source_text: Your choice. Can I ask you some more questions?

text: 随你。我能再问你点问题吗？
source_text: 随你。我能再问你点问题吗？

text: Please hurry and rid us of those Rad Scorpions!
source_text: Please hurry and rid us of those Rad Scorpions!

text: 请尽快帮我们消灭掉那些辐射蝎！
source_text: 请尽快帮我们消灭掉那些辐射蝎！

text: Things are much more settled now. Razlo has been working#on a cure for Rad Scorpion poison, and with that, we should be#able to fight what's left of them.
source_text:
Things are much more settled now. Razlo has been working
#on a cure for Rad Scorpion poison, and with that, we should be
#able to fight what's left of them.

text: 现在事情稳定多了。拉斯洛正在弄蝎毒的治疗方法，有了这个，我们应该就可以把还剩下来的辐射蝎消灭了。
source_text: 现在事情稳定多了。拉斯洛正在弄蝎毒的治疗方法，有了这个，我们应该就可以把还剩下来的辐射蝎消灭了。

text: It was nothing. Can I ask you some more questions?
source_text: It was nothing. Can I ask you some more questions?

text: 没什么。我可以再问你些问题吗？
source_text: 没什么。我可以再问你些问题吗？

text: You don't need to worry anymore. I destroyed the Nest.
source_text: You don't need to worry anymore. I destroyed the Nest.

text: 你不需要再担心什么了。我消灭了他们的巢穴。
source_text: 你不需要再担心什么了。我消灭了他们的巢穴。

text: You are truly a hero! Know that the people of Shady#Sands are most grateful.
source_text:
You are truly a hero! Know that the people of Shady
#Sands are most grateful.

text: 你是一个真英雄！我们沙荫镇的人民非常感激你。
source_text: 你是一个真英雄！我们沙荫镇的人民非常感激你。

text: Thanks. Can I ask you a few more questions, though?
source_text: Thanks. Can I ask you a few more questions, though?

text: 谢谢。那么我能再问你一些问题吗？
source_text: 谢谢。那么我能再问你一些问题吗？

text: Thanks. Bye!
source_text: Thanks. Bye!

text: 谢谢。再见！
source_text: 谢谢。再见！

text: If you can understand me, please try to find my#daughter.
source_text:
If you can understand me, please try to find my
#daughter.

text: 如果你知道我的意思，请你找到我的女儿。
source_text: 如果你知道我的意思，请你找到我的女儿。

text: Since you brought my Tandi back to me, things are#quite fine. My eternal gratitude to you, wanderer.
source_text:
Since you brought my Tandi back to me, things are
#quite fine. My eternal gratitude to you, wanderer.

text: 在你把我的坦蒂救回来后，一切很好。请接受我我永恒的感激，旅行者。
source_text: 在你把我的坦蒂救回来后，一切很好。请接受我我永恒的感激，旅行者。

text: What can you tell me about the other towns around#here?

What can you tell me about the other towns around
#here?

text: 你能告诉我这里附近城镇的事情吗？
source_text: 你能告诉我这里附近城镇的事情吗？

text: What's going on around here?
source_text: What's going on around here?

text: 镇子里有什么事吗？
source_text: 镇子里有什么事吗？

text: Thanks. Bye.
source_text: Thanks. Bye.

text: 谢谢。再见。
source_text: 谢谢。再见。

text: Yes, yes. Umm. Have a good stay.
source_text: Yes, yes. Umm. Have a good stay.

text: 是，是。嗯。祝你在这愉快。
source_text: 是，是。嗯。祝你在这愉快。

text: Ahh, wanderer. How goes the search for my daughter?
source_text: Ahh, wanderer. How goes the search for my daughter?

text: 啊，旅行者。寻找我女儿有什么进展吗？
source_text: 啊，旅行者。寻找我女儿有什么进展吗？

text: Sorry, but I haven't found her. I will, though.
source_text: Sorry, but I haven't found her. I will, though.

text: 抱歉，不过我还没有找到她。不过我会的。
source_text: 抱歉，不过我还没有找到她。不过我会的。

text: I'm sorry, but she is dead.
source_text: I'm sorry, but she is dead.

text: 我非常遗憾，她已经死了。
source_text: 我非常遗憾，她已经死了。

text: Duh-nada.
source_text: Duh-nada.

text: 啊——啊啊。
source_text: 啊——啊啊。

text: Sorry, but I haven't found her. I will, though.
source_text: Sorry, but I haven't found her. I will, though.

text: 抱歉，不过我还没有找到她。不过我会的。
source_text: 抱歉，不过我还没有找到她。不过我会的。

text: Slow, but I am making some progress. Can I ask you# a few more questions?
source_text:
Slow, but I am making some progress. Can I ask you
# a few more questions?

text: 不太乐观，不过正有进展。我能再问你一些问题吗？
source_text: 不太乐观，不过正有进展。我能再问你一些问题吗？

text: Guunngggg!
source_text: Guunngggg!

text: 咕嗯!
source_text: 咕嗯!

text: Thank you for trying. Please leave me to my grief.
source_text: Thank you for trying. Please leave me to my grief.

text: 你尽力了，谢谢。请让我一个人静静的哀悼。
source_text: 你尽力了，谢谢。请让我一个人静静的哀悼。

text: May my thoughts be wings to your feet. Please hurry.
source_text: May my thoughts be wings to your feet. Please hurry.

text: 愿你的思想成为你脚步的翅膀。请尽快。
source_text: 愿你的思想成为你脚步的翅膀。请尽快。

text: Thank goodness you came! I am in desperate# need of assistance. My daughter, Tandi, is missing.# I do not know what to do!
source_text:
Thank goodness you came! I am in desperate
# need of assistance. My daughter, Tandi, is missing.
# I do not know what to do!

text: 谢天谢地你来了！我急需你的帮助。我的女儿，坦蒂，失踪了。我不知道应该做什么！
source_text: 谢天谢地你来了！我急需你的帮助。我的女儿，坦蒂，失踪了。我不知道应该做什么！

text: Have you tried to save her?
source_text: Have you tried to save her?

text: 你营救过她吗？
source_text: 你营救过她吗？

text: Uhh?
source_text: Uhh?

text: 啊？
source_text: 啊？

text: My people are not skilled in this. Already three patrols# have gone out to look, but none returned. Will you help me?
source_text:
My people are not skilled in this. Already three patrols
# have gone out to look, but none returned. Will you help me?

text: 我的人民不擅长这些。已经有三支巡逻队去寻找了，不过还没有任何一队回来。你会帮我吗？
source_text: 我的人民不擅长这些。已经有三支巡逻队去寻找了，不过还没有任何一队回来。你会帮我吗？

text: Okay. Who could have taken her?
source_text: Okay. Who could have taken her?

text: 好吧。谁可能把她带走？
source_text: 好吧。谁可能把她带走？

text: I'll do it . . . for a fee.
source_text: I'll do it . . . for a fee.

text: 我能帮你的忙……不过你要出点血。
source_text: 我能帮你的忙……不过你要出点血。

text: I am sorry, but I have other things I have to do.
source_text: I am sorry, but I have other things I have to do.

text: 我很抱歉，不过我还有别的该去做的事。
source_text: 我很抱歉，不过我还有别的该去做的事。

text: Seth and I believe one of the raider clans is# responsible - retribution for our resistance to# them. Take this spear. It was found where my daughter# was last seen.
source_text:
Seth and I believe one of the raider clans is
# responsible - retribution for our resistance to
# them. Take this spear. It was found where my daughter
# was last seen.

text: 赛思和我相信是其中一伙强盗干的——为了报复我们的抵抗。拿上这把矛。这是我在女儿失踪的地方找到的。
source_text: 赛思和我相信是其中一伙强盗干的——为了报复我们的抵抗。拿上这把矛。这是我在女儿失踪的地方找到的。

text: Okay, I'll check it out.
source_text: Okay, I'll check it out.

text: 好的，我会去查查。
source_text: 好的，我会去查查。

text: Please, talk to Seth. He knows much about these# raiders. And God speed, wanderer.
source_text:
Please, talk to Seth. He knows much about these
# raiders. And God speed, wanderer.

text: 请和赛思谈谈。他知道很多关于歹徒的事。十万火急啊，旅行者。
source_text: 请和赛思谈谈。他知道很多关于歹徒的事。十万火急啊，旅行者。

text: Of course, I will reward you. Bring her and you# will receive 500 in Hub Script. Will you help me?
source_text:
Of course, I will reward you. Bring her and you
# will receive 500 in Hub Script. Will you help me?

text: 当然，我会给你报酬的。把她带回来，你会获得500哈勃币。你会帮我吗？
source_text: 当然，我会给你报酬的。把她带回来，你会获得500哈勃币。你会帮我吗？

text: Okay. Who could have taken her?
source_text: Okay. Who could have taken her?

text: 好吧。谁可能带走她？
source_text: 好吧。谁可能带走她？

text: Ah . . . no thanks. I got other stuff I gotta# take care of.
source_text:
Ah . . . no thanks. I got other stuff I gotta
# take care of.

text: 啊……不，谢了。我还有别的事要做。
source_text: 啊……不，谢了。我还有别的事要做。

text: As Dharma said, 'While you are out hunting the# wolves, do not bring the lion to your den.' If you will# not help, you must leave here.
source_text:
As Dharma said, 'While you are out hunting the
# wolves, do not bring the lion to your den.' If you will
# not help, you must leave here.

text: 达玛说过，“前门御狼，后门防虎。”如果你不帮忙，你就必须离开这里。
source_text: 达玛说过，“前门御狼，后门防虎。”如果你不帮忙，你就必须离开这里。

text: I will be forever in your debt for your courage and# bravery, wanderer. Here is your reward.
source_text:
I will be forever in your debt for your courage and
# bravery, wanderer. Here is your reward.

text: 为你的勇气和胆量，我将永生感恩不尽，旅行者。这里是你的报酬。
source_text: 为你的勇气和胆量，我将永生感恩不尽，旅行者。这里是你的报酬。

text: Thanks. Can I ask you a few more questions, first?
source_text: Thanks. Can I ask you a few more questions, first?

text: 谢谢。我可以先再问你一些问题吗？
source_text: 谢谢。我可以先再问你一些问题吗？

text: Thanks.
source_text: Thanks.

text: 谢谢。
source_text: 谢谢。

text: Until we meet again, my friend. May the water you find# in the desert not shine at you in the dark.
source_text:
Until we meet again, my friend. May the water you find
# in the desert not shine at you in the dark.

text: 来日再见，我的朋友。愿你总能在沙漠里发现不会在夜里闪闪发光的水。
source_text: 来日再见，我的朋友。愿你总能在沙漠里发现不会在夜里闪闪发光的水。

text: What are you doing? Put that back at once!
source_text: What are you doing? Put that back at once!

text: 你在干什么？马上把它放回去！
source_text: 你在干什么？马上把它放回去！

text: That is not yours. Please do not take it.
source_text: That is not yours. Please do not take it.

text: 这个不是你的。请你不要拿走它。
source_text: 这个不是你的。请你不要拿走它。

text: Stop that at once!
source_text: Stop that at once!

text: 马上停止那么做！
source_text: 马上停止那么做！

text: What are you doing here? I am resting, come back in the morning!
source_text: What are you doing here? I am resting, come back in the morning!

text: 你在这里干什么？我正在休息，早上再来吧！
source_text: 你在这里干什么？我正在休息，早上再来吧！

text: I am he. I lead this humble town of Shady Sands.
source_text: I am he. I lead this humble town of Shady Sands.

text: 我就是那个领导着沙荫镇的人。
source_text: 我就是那个领导着沙荫镇的人。

text: Dharma was a great, religious man. You would do well to# listen closely to his sayings.
source_text:
Dharma was a great, religious man. You would do well to
# listen closely to his sayings.

text: 达玛是个伟大而虔诚的人。遵从他的指引，你就会成功。
source_text: 达玛是个伟大而虔诚的人。遵从他的指引，你就会成功。

text: She is my daughter. It is she that makes this hard# life worth living.
source_text:
She is my daughter. It is she that makes this hard
# life worth living.

text: 她是我的女儿，就是因为她，这里一切艰苦的生活都是值得的。
source_text: 她是我的女儿，就是因为她，这里一切艰苦的生活都是值得的。

text: Hmm, yes, yes. Razlo is our doctor. If it ails you,# he can heal it. I would wager he is just a little# north of here at this moment.
source_text:
Hmm, yes, yes. Razlo is our doctor. If it ails you,
# he can heal it. I would wager he is just a little
# north of here at this moment.

text: 嗯，是的，是的，拉斯洛是我们的医生。他能治疗沙漠蝎的蛰伤。这会儿他肯定在这稍北处的房子里。
source_text: 嗯，是的，是的，拉斯洛是我们的医生。他能治疗沙漠蝎的蛰伤。这会儿他肯定在这稍北处的房子里。

text: A fine young man, Seth. Captain of our guards. He# is likely to be at the Guard House.
source_text:
A fine young man, Seth. Captain of our guards. He
# is likely to be at the Guard House.

text: 赛思是个棒小伙。我们卫兵的队长。他可能在镇口的门房边。
